description:
Every time your iPhone detects a car crash and calls for help, your Apple Watch notices you’ve started a workout before you tell it to, or “Hey Siri” wakes up without you touching a thing, there’s a tiny, always-on processor making it happen. At Apple, the Always-On Processor (AOP) firmware team builds the software that runs on that silicon. We write the firmware that listens to the world through accelerometers, gyroscopes, barometers, magnetometers, and more, while sipping just microwatts of power. 

Our work sits underneath features people rely on every day, from emergency response and fitness tracking to camera image stabilization, spatial audio, intuitive device interactions, and all-day battery life. Because the same platform spans iPhone, Apple Watch, iPad, Mac, AirPods, and Vision Pro, a line of code you write can ship in products used by hundreds of millions of people. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something!

Description
The Core Operating Systems (Core OS) team is responsible for the foundational software used in Apple’s most iconic and beloved products. We’re looking for a talented Embedded Software Engineer to join the Always On Platform Systems team. This team is uniquely positioned to contribute to all Apple products and has a wide range of responsibilities including: pre-silicon software development, hardware bringup, sensor driver development and integration, as well as future framework and feature development for the Always On technology area. The team also has oversight responsibilities in architecture, compute and memory resourcing, and cross-functional feature deployment. 

The ideal candidate must possess a genuine passion for hardware/software integration, software quality, and the ability to collaborate and communicate effectively across teams. This is a rare opportunity to help build cutting-edge foundational technologies and have a direct impact on Apple’s widely loved products across the globe.

Responsibilities
Design, develop, and test embedded software for low-power, resource-constrained environments.
Optimize code for performance, power consumption, and memory footprint.
Collaborate with silicon and hardware engineers to define and implement system-level capabilities.
Contribute to the architecture and design of the Always-On platform.
Debug and troubleshoot complex software issues in a real-world context.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to best practices.
Work closely with other teams across Apple to integrate your work seamlessly into the broader ecosystem.
Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in embedded systems technology.


Minimum qualifications
Proven experience in embedded software development.
Strong proficiency in C/C++ programming.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
BS degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent skills/experience.

Preferred qualifications
Experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS).
Familiarity with hardware architectures (ARM preferred).
Solid Hardware and Software debugging skills.
Understanding of common peripheral busses (SPI/I2C/USB)
Experience with sensor integration.
Knowledge of Apple platforms and technologies.
